text:
maya: I'm seeing inconsistent exception attrs from async client when we hit 401s. sometimes ApiError has raw_body, sometimes not
sam: is this in tests or prod? any proxy/token refresh in between?
maya: tests hitting hosted endpoint simulator. snippet:
```py
async with RedwoodClient(api_key=KEY) as c:
    await c.responses.create(... )
```
maya: if server returns malformed JSON body we lose raw bytes in ApiError and only get "unexpected json" message
alex: that's byproduct of parse->convert->raise flow; we intended to keep raw bytes but code path drops it
sam: also saw Unclosed connector when parse fails during async __aenter__ path; session cleanup missing
maya: requests: (1) always attach status_code and raw_body (bytes) to exceptions (2) provide error_json if parse ok (3) doc update + typing so functions mention raised exceptions
ale: propose adding client init hook e.g. on_auth_failure(refresh_func) that can return new token and auto-retry once for 401s
sam: won't be default; default: no retry for non-5xx. add tests for both JSON and non-JSON 401 bodies and for connector leak
lee-bot: /link https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/issues/699 (auto-created) :robot_face:
maya: tiny DX ask: include hint in repr: "Tip: set REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 to show raw response" when debug env set
ale: I'll take exception shape + typing changes. sam take async session cleanup + tests
sam: /assign @alex @sam
maya: thanks y'all
